<file>
00001| #!/bin/bash
00002| 
00003| # PropScan Simple Installation Script (No pip required)
00004| 
00005| set -e
00006| 
00007| # Colors for output
00008| RED='\033[0;31m'
00009| GREEN='\033[0;32m'
00010| YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
00011| BLUE='\033[0;34m'
00012| NC='\033[0m' # No Color
00013| 
00014| print_status() {
00015|     echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
00016| }
00017| 
00018| print_success() {
00019|     echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
00020| }
00021| 
00022| print_warning() {
00023|     echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
00024| }
00025| 
00026| print_error() {
00027|     echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
00028| }
00029| 
00030| check_python() {
00031|     print_status "Checking Python 3..."
00032|     
00033|     if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
00034|         print_error "Python 3 is required but not installed."
00035|         exit 1
00036|     fi
00037|     
00038|     print_success "Python 3 found: $(python3 --version)"
00039| }
00040| 
00041| install_dependencies() {
00042|     print_status "Installing Python dependencies..."
00043|     
00044|     # Install dependencies using python3 -m pip (works even without pip command)
00045|     python3 -m pip install --user click tabulate colorama
00046|     
00047|     print_success "Dependencies installed!"
00048| }
00049| 
00050| install_propscan() {
00051|     print_status "Installing PropScan..."
00052|     
00053|     # Create local bin directory if it doesn't exist
00054|     mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
00055|     
00056|     # Copy the propscan script to local bin
00057|     cat > "$HOME/.local/bin/propscan" << 'EOF'
00058| #!/usr/bin/env python3
00059| 
00060| import sys
00061| import os
00062| 
00063| # Add the propscan source directory to Python path
00064| propscan_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'propscan', 'src')
00065| sys.path.insert(0, propscan_dir)
00066| 
00067| from propscan.cli import main
00068| 
00069| if __name__ == "__main__":
00070|     main()
00071| EOF
00072|     
00073|     chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
00074|     
00075|     # Copy source files to ~/.local/share/propscan
00076|     INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/propscan"
00077|     mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR"
00078|     cp -r src/* "$INSTALL_DIR/"
00079|     
00080|     print_success "PropScan installed to $HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
00081| }
00082| 
00083| setup_path() {
00084|     print_status "Setting up PATH..."
00085|     
00086|     # Check if ~/.local/bin is in PATH
00087|     if [[ ":$PATH:" != *":$HOME/.local/bin:"* ]]; then
00088|         print_warning "~/.local/bin is not in your PATH"
00089|         print_status "Adding to ~/.bashrc..."
00090|         
00091|         echo '' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
00092|         echo '# Added by PropScan installer' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
00093|         echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
00094|         
00095|         print_success "Added ~/.local/bin to PATH in ~/.bashrc"
00096|         print_status "Please run: source ~/.bashrc"
00097|     else
00098|         print_success "PATH is already configured"
00099|     fi
00100| }
00101| 
00102| create_desktop_entry() {
00103|     print_status "Creating desktop entry..."
00104|     
00105|     LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/applications"
00106|     mkdir -p "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR"
00107|     
00108|     cat > "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR/propscan.desktop" << EOF
00109| [Desktop Entry]
00110| Version=1.0
00111| Type=Application
00112| Name=PropScan
00113| Comment=Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems
00114| Exec=$HOME/.local/bin/propscan
00115| Icon=security-high
00116| Terminal=true
00117| Categories=System;Security;
00118| Keywords=proprietary;software;scan;package;manager;
00119| EOF
00120|     
00121|     print_success "Desktop entry created."
00122| }
00123| 
00124| show_usage() {
00125|     print_success "Installation completed!"
00126|     echo
00127|     print_status "Usage examples:"
00128|     echo "  propscan                    # Scan all package managers"
00129|     echo "  propscan -m flatpak         # Scan only Flatpak"
00130|     echo "  propscan -f json            # Output as JSON"
00131|     echo "  propscan --list-managers    # List available package managers"
00132|     echo "  propscan --help             # Show help"
00133|     echo
00134|     print_status "If 'propscan' command is not found, run:"
00135|     echo "  source ~/.bashrc"
00136|     echo "  # or"
00137|     echo "  export PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\""
00138|     echo
00139| }
00140| 
00141| main() {
00142|     echo "PropScan Simple Installation Script"
00143|     echo "==================================="
00144|     echo
00145|     
00146|     check_python
00147|     install_dependencies
00148|     install_propscan
00149|     setup_path
00150|     create_desktop_entry
00151|     show_usage
00152| }
00153| 
00154| main "$@"
</file>
